upload.title: 퇴사 다음 날, 알람이 울지 않았다 | 평일 오후 세 시 #shorts
upload.description:
알람이 울지 않는 아침.
넥타이는 옷장 속에서 잠이 들었습니다.

카프카 『변신』의 그레고르처럼, 퇴사 다음 날 나는 벌레가 된 것만 같았습니다.
그런데 평일 오후 세 시, 처음 보는 햇살 아래서 딸아이가 물었습니다. "아빠 오늘 회사 안 가?"
오늘은 너한테 출근했어.

🎵 평일 오후 세 시 - MIDLIFE COMMUTER
💬 회사 대신 처음 '출근'한 곳은 어디였나요? 댓글로 들려주세요. 다음 노래가 됩니다.

가사는 사람이 쓰고, 음악(ACE-Step)과 그림은 AI와 함께 만들었습니다.

scenes.plate: a small Korean apartment bedroom in soft morning light, an unmade bed with a white blanket, a round alarm clock on the nightstand showing half past seven, thin curtains glowing with sunlight
scenes.motion: the man stands by the bed and looks at the silent alarm clock, the thin curtains sway softly in the morning breeze, dust floats in the sunlight

scenes.plate: an open wooden wardrobe in a Korean apartment bedroom, a row of neckties and white shirts and dark suits hanging inside, morning light from the side
scenes.motion: the man stands still in front of the open wardrobe looking at the hanging neckties, the neckties sway gently, morning light shifts slowly on the wall

scenes.plate: a dim Korean apartment bedroom at late morning with the curtains half closed, a rumpled bed with a thick blanket, a sunny windowsill with a small potted plant and a tiny brown beetle on the sill
scenes.motion: the man stands by the rumpled bed with a tired sigh, a tiny brown beetle slowly crawls along the sunny windowsill, the curtain moves a little

scenes.plate: a quiet empty Korean apartment living room at midday, a sofa, a low table with a cold cup of coffee, a wall clock, children's school bags gone from their hooks, flat grey light
scenes.motion: the man stands alone in the silent living room and lowers his shoulders, the wall clock's second hand ticks, the light slowly brightens through the window

scenes.plate: a bright Korean apartment complex walkway on a sunny weekday afternoon, golden ginkgo trees, warm sunlight and long soft shadows, flower beds, a clear blue sky
scenes.extras: an old lady walking slowly with a shopping cart far behind, a mail carrier in a blue uniform walking with a bag
scenes.motion: the man looks up into the warm afternoon sunlight with surprise, golden ginkgo leaves float down around him, the old lady walks slowly in the distance

scenes.plate: a colorful apartment complex playground in Korea on a sunny afternoon, a slide, swings, a sandbox, golden ginkgo trees around it
scenes.extras: young children playing on the slide and in the sandbox, a grandmother watching from beside the swings
scenes.motion: children laugh and slide down the slide and dig in the sandbox, the grandmother claps, the man watches them with a soft smile, leaves drift down

scenes.plate: in front of the gate of a Korean elementary school on a sunny afternoon, a red brick school building and a schoolyard behind, golden ginkgo trees along the fence
scenes.extras: a few schoolchildren with backpacks walking out of the schoolyard far behind
scenes.motion: the little girl tilts her head and looks up at her father with curious eyes, the father smiles warmly and nods, ginkgo leaves fall

scenes.plate: a quiet Korean neighborhood sidewalk lined with golden ginkgo trees on a sunny afternoon, small shops and a stationery store, warm long shadows
scenes.motion: the father and his little daughter walk side by side along the sidewalk, the girl swings her arms happily, golden leaves fall around them

scenes.plate: a sunny Korean apartment kitchen in the morning, breakfast on the table, a frying pan with eggs on the stove, a window with morning sun, a silent alarm clock on the counter
scenes.motion: steam rises from the frying pan, the children laugh and chatter, the man smiles at them warmly, morning sunlight fills the kitchen

scenes.plate: a walking path along a small stream in a Korean city park on a sunny afternoon, reeds and golden trees by the water, a stepping-stone bridge, apartment buildings far behind
scenes.motion: the family stands together by the stream laughing, the wife leans toward her husband, the children point at the water, reeds sway in the wind

scenes.plate: an apartment complex playground at golden sunset in Korea, empty swings, long warm shadows, golden ginkgo trees
scenes.motion: the father and daughter stand together in the golden sunset light and smile at each other, the empty swings sway gently in the breeze

scenes.plate: a window of a Korean apartment at sunset seen from inside, warm orange sky over the apartment complex, a child's crayon drawing of a smiling dad taped to the glass
scenes.motion: the man stands still by the window and gazes at the warm sunset sky with a calm face, clouds drift slowly, the sky glows orange
